prompt: During startup, Apache reports it cannot resolve any VirtualHost entries. What could cause this? (Choose two.)
choices: The VirtualHost directives are incorrect in httpd.conf
The Apache process died before the virtual hosts were configured
The network is up but name resolution is not running yet, so Apache cannot DNS-check the virtual hosts
The network is not yet configured, so Apache cannot DNS-check the virtual hosts
explanation: If DNS or the network is not ready when Apache starts, it cannot resolve the virtual host names.
